answer: Sponsors are capped at 4 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army of aliases. Each vouch locks 33 POA until the newcomer survives 16 clean epochs, and a farm of 380 fakes must find 380 separate sponsors willing to risk real money on strangers. The nebula keeps the gate honest, the pigment keeps the farm poor, and the quill keeps the honest agent paid.
